cases.name: rfc6238-generator-vectors
cases.evidence: Two published SHA1 8-digit reference vectors passed; server policy is 6 digits / 30 seconds

cases.name: fixed-version-two-node-mfa
cases.evidence: Built-in TOTP / recovery-codes:v1 / step-up:v1 loaded; two-member JDBC_PING cluster

cases.name: unbound-user-must-enroll
cases.evidence: A valid password alone reaches mandatory TOTP enrollment, not authorization

cases.name: invalid-enrollment-not-persisted
cases.evidence: Wrong setup code rejected; admin credential listing confirms no OTP stored

cases.name: totp-and-recovery-enrollment
cases.evidence: TOTP confirmed and 12 sequential recovery codes generated/acknowledged through required-action forms

cases.name: first-factor-required
cases.evidence: Wrong password cannot proceed to the independent TOTP challenge

cases.name: missing-second-factor-rejected
cases.evidence: Password plus empty TOTP cannot obtain an authorization result

evidence.signature: RS256 verified with trusted realm JWKS

cases.name: tampered-assurance-claim-rejected
cases.evidence: Changing the JWT ACR without the realm signing key fails cryptographic verification

cases.name: totp-time-step-reuse-rejected
cases.evidence: A previously accepted TOTP is rejected in a fresh authentication session on the other node

cases.name: malformed-totp-rejected
cases.evidence: Direct HTTP submission with non-digit TOTP is rejected server-side

cases.name: stale-and-future-totp-rejected
cases.evidence: Codes four time steps away are rejected with look-ahead window 0

cases.name: lost-device-recovery-code
cases.evidence: Password plus the next sequential offline recovery code completes level 2 without the TOTP device

cases.name: recovery-replay-rejected-next-code-valid
cases.evidence: Consumed recovery code rejected on a fresh form; next code succeeds

cases.name: recovery-regeneration-revokes-old-set
cases.evidence: Re-authenticated AIA replaces recovery set; an unused old code fails and a new code works

cases.name: rebind-requires-existing-second-factor
cases.evidence: Knowing only the password cannot enter replacement-device enrollment

cases.name: device-rebind-old-device-revoked
cases.evidence: Password + recovery proof -> new TOTP confirmation -> explicit administrator revocation of old device and sessions -> old SSO cookie prompt=none returned login_required -> old code rejected/new code accepted

cases.name: cross-node-brute-force-lock
cases.evidence: Three invalid TOTP submissions trigger a temporary account lock; correct first factor on node B cannot bypass it

cases.name: sso-step-up-and-downgrade-prevention
cases.evidence: Existing level-1 SSO still challenges TOTP; high client's minimum ACR 2 overrides acr_values=1

cases.name: fresh-mfa-and-silent-auth-denial
cases.evidence: LoA2 max-age=0 forces each new high-assurance authorization to challenge; prompt=none cannot mint tokens

cases.name: verified-assurance-boundary
cases.evidence: Only cryptographically verified level-2 claims meet the local BFF assurance predicate; no production business API implemented

limitations: Local HTTP integration probe; no phone authenticator, WebAuthn, Google or ERP/BFF acceptance
Recovery rotation includes explicit controlled administrator revocation, not a completed self-service recovery product
No network partition, full cache loss, production clock drift or external support identity-proofing acceptance
